root_materiality_ruling.N2_Reti2019_DimitrovStevanovic2023: NOT MATERIAL. These are the origin papers of sigma_t. The source arXiv:2411.04881 cites both in its abstract and is coauthored by Darko Dimitrov (coauthor of D-S 2023); it poses Conjecture 24 after both works and the refereed Ars Math. Contemp. 26 (2026) version retains it as Conjecture 6.1. A full resolution in a coauthor's prior paper is not a credible risk; residual risk is only a partial lemma, which would not make the result a routine corollary of a stated theorem.
root_materiality_ruling.N1_Bell1992: NOT MATERIAL (residual risk disclosed). Two independent body-level restatements read by reviewers (Zhou 2004 Remark 4 p.115; Elphick-Wocjan 2014 p.52) describe Bell's results as unrestricted fixed-edge M1 bounds and unrestricted variance/spectral extremizers (quasi-clique/quasi-star). Zhou proves the triangle-free M1<=nm bound (Theorem 5) and cites Bell only for unrestricted bounds; a triangle-free Bell result would have been the natural citation there. Caro-Yuster 2000 (read in full), which builds on this line, has only unrestricted maxima. The 2026 refereed source discusses Caro-Yuster and keeps the conjecture open.
root_materiality_ruling.N3_strict_gap: NARROWED, accepted as bounded limitation. No strict Zagreb deficit theorem found in bodies read (Elphick-Wocjan Thm 4.1, Vaidya-Chang 2409.06081, refined Turan, 2606.17356). The focused review shows D>=1 is insufficient at n=10 (615 > 576), so the n-2 gap is a genuine new ingredient, not the classical equality case.
